card.name: Verbs of dismissing or rejecting
card.fires_on: Verbs meaning to dismiss, ignore, refuse or turn away from something, such as dismisses, ignored, refused, turned down, shied away and turns a blind eye. It fires on the verb just before the thing being brushed aside.

modes.label: Dismiss or ignore
modes.description: A verb saying someone waves off or disregards an idea or fact.
modes.example: This approach<< dismiss>>es an old, cheap, and safe

modes.label: Refuse or turn down
modes.description: A verb saying an offer is declined or something is avoided.
modes.example: The team's owners<< turned>> down the offer, as Youngstown was

modes.label: Shy away or look away
modes.description: Phrases for avoiding an issue, such as shied away or turns a blind eye.
modes.example: Those familiar with Mr. Mo’s work point out he has not sh<<ied>> away from sensitive issues.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning dismiss, reject or avoid, including Chinese equivalents.
card.plain: It spots verbs where someone brushes off, refuses or avoids something.
